title: The Truth of Ye Qing's Betrayal
next_chapter_hook: Just as the light from the mural illuminated the truth of destiny, a familiar figure slowly stepped out from the shadows—Ye Qing's eyes carried the same exhaustion and despair as Chen Ji's.

text.content: That aged voice exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, his fingers unconsciously gripping the Tianji Record Fragment hidden in his sleeve. The crimson gaze seemed to pierce through his very soul—not merely a simple stare, but an examination transcending mortal will, like a deity looking down upon ants. "Key..." Chen Ji repeated the word endlessly in his heart, his expression betraying nothing, only a cold light flickering in the depths of his eyes. Mo Xiansheng, how much more have you hidden from me? The Tianji Record, the Heavenly Secrets Cage—the connection between them runs far deeper and more complex than what he had just revealed.

The corridor of the ruins stretched deep and endless, the flames on the bronze lanterns burning an eerie ghostly blue, casting the surrounding murals as if alive and writhing. Chen Ji walked forward slowly, his gaze sweeping across the walls on both sides—those ancient and ferocious patterns recorded a history unknown to him. Immortals worshipping the Heavenly Secrets, all beings reduced to chess pieces, prophets holding fragmented scrolls... When he saw the final mural, his pupils contracted sharply. At its center, a massive eyeball floated above the Nine Heavens, its crimson pupil identical to what he had sensed moments before. Countless figures knelt prostrate beneath it—one clearly wearing the robes of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path.

dialogue.content: "Do you see it?" Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a sense of vicissitudes and helplessness. "That eye is the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. It is not some deity or manifestation of the Heavenly Will as you might imagine—it is an existence far more ancient and ruthless than either. Ten thousand years ago, it branded its will into the laws of heaven and earth. From that moment on, all prophets in the world became its chess pieces." The residual soul's voice trembled slightly. "The Tianji Record is merely one of the tools it uses to manipulate destiny."

text.content: Chen Ji stopped, his fingertips gently tracing the crimson eye's patterns on the mural, the touch ice-cold and bone-piercing. Ten thousand years of scheming, a chess game spanning countless epochs—suddenly, he understood something. "So Ye Qing..." His voice was low and dangerous. "She was also a chosen chess piece?" Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment before speaking: "The Holy Saint lineage of the Demonic Path is itself one of the pieces the Eye of Heavenly Secrets placed in the mortal world. In every generation of saints, its will-imprint has been embedded. When the imprint is activated, they are compelled to execute certain commands—even if their clear minds are filled with resistance, their bodies cannot obey their own will."

Deep within the mural, a hidden door silently opened, revealing a chamber within. Chen Ji stepped inside, and the scene before him made his breath catch—a preserved corpse lay on the stone platform in the chamber's center, and embedded in the corpse's chest was a jet-black eyeball-shaped crystal, identical to the Eye of Heavenly Secrets on the mural. On the stone wall beside the corpse, names were densely carved, each name accompanied by birth dates and death hours. At the very bottom, one line read—"Su Qingyao, Gengzi Year, Third Day of Seventh Month, Fate Altered, Pending." Chen Jisneered一声，那笑意却不达眼底。

dialogue.content: "What you see is the record of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets manipulating fate across generations." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried an undeniable sorrow. "Those names are all prophets it once selected and then abandoned. Every Tianji Record inheritor has left their mark here—including your father, Chen Xuan." Chen Ji's fingertip stopped on a freshly carved name on the stone wall: "Chen Nian, Xinchou Year, Fifteenth Day of Seventh Month, Heavenly Fate Key, Activated." In his pupils, killing intent coalesced like substantial essence. Father, sister, Ye Qing... So his entire family had been targeted by this damnable eye from the very beginning.

text.content: He continued downward, discovering a line of deliberately scratched-out text, from which a few characters could barely be made out—"Demonic Saint, Wheel of Pain, Will-Imprint Activation Conditions..." The content after was scraped away with a sharp instrument, but Chen Ji敏锐地注意到，刮痕的边缘残留着淡淡的指甲痕迹，仿佛留下记录的人在极度agonized中struggling着想要抹去真相。"这是夜清做的？"他问道。墨先生sighing道："是她。她在继承圣女之位时觉醒了部分记忆，发现了自己体内的烙印，于是冒着魂飞魄散的风险潜入此地，试图抹去关于烙印激活条件的内容——但她失败了。天道之眼的烙印极为特殊，一旦尝试强行删除，记录便会自动修复。"

dialogue.content: 就在这时，密室深处传来一阵微弱的呻吟。陈机猛地转身，只见石台后方蜷缩着一个身影——那人身着魔道圣宗的黑色长裙，乌黑的长发散乱在地，露出的手臂上布满了狰狞的黑色纹路，如同某种被强行刻入体内的restriction。她的面容苍白如纸，却依稀能够辨认出那张曾让陈机在布局时hesitated三分的脸——夜清。她的嘴唇slightly翕动，发出断断续续的呓语："不是……不是我……我不想……陈机……快跑……它要……"陈机的拳头suddenly攥紧，关节发出咔咔的响声。

text.content: Chen Ji approached slowly, kneeling to examine Ye Qing's condition. Her body temperature was terrifyingly cold, the black patterns on her body spreading visibly, each pulse accompanied by her agonized expression. Chen Ji reached for her pulse, but the moment he touched it, he sensed a familiar yet dangerous aura—a resonance with the Tianji Record Fragment, precisely the will-imprint of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. "So back at the Holy Sect, when she suddenly attacked me..." Chen Ji's voice was low as an abyss. "It was because the imprint was activated?" Mo Xianshengpensive良久，终于说道："圣宗之所以一定要置你于死地，正是因为天机录的传承者，是唯一能够破解烙印的存在。你的存在本身，对天道之眼的布局就是一种threatening——而夜清，正是被他们利用来除掉你的工具。"

choice.prompt: 看着眼前被烙印折磨得agonized不堪的夜清，陈机心中翻涌着complex的情绪。她曾是他的盟友，也是他在布局中唯一trust的魔道之人。如今得知她的一切背叛都是身不由己，他该如何抉择？

choices.text: "以德报怨，替她分担烙印之痛"
choices.description: Ye Qing once fought for you, once shielded you from lethal blows. Now she is controlled by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets and reduced to a chess piece—you cannot stand by indifferently. Use the power of the Tianji Record to attempt suppressing the imprint within her, even if it consumes substantial Heavenly Fate.

text.content: The Tianji Record's golden light collided violently with the black patterns within Ye Qing's body, emitting an ear-piercing shriek. Chen Ji felt an unprecedented backlash surge through the golden light into his body—the will of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets roared: "Insignificant ant, dare you disrupt my grand design!" The intense pain contorted his features, but he gritted his teeth and forcibly suppressed this force. Golden light and black patterns engaged in a tug-of-war within Ye Qing's body, and her gaze gradually regained clarity. "Chen... Chen Ji?" Her voice was hoarse and weak. "Why... why would you save me? I've harmed you so many times..." Chen Ji offered no answer, only pressing his palm more firmly, veins standing out on his forehead.

choices.text: "Calmly analyze and first understand the imprint's complete mechanism"
choices.description: Though Ye Qing's betrayal was involuntary, she is after all a person of the Demonic Path, and the imprint in her body may have other hidden dangers. Before acting on emotion, one must first understand everything—this has always been your style, Chen Ji.
choices.visible_reward: Gain complete intelligence on the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' imprint, unlock "Know Your Enemy" buff

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand and stepped back two paces, his gaze sharp as a blade scanning every black pattern on Ye Qing. Her eyes dimmed, a bitter smile forming at her lips: "You still don't trust me..." Chen Ji shook his head, his voice terrifyingly calm: "It's not distrust—I cannot be blind." He knelt down, fingertips hovering above the black patterns, beginning to carefully analyze their trajectory and patterns. After a moment, he discovered the key—the patterns were not simply a restriction, but a bidirectional conduit. They were not only suppressing Ye Qing's consciousness but also continuously channeling a portion of her power to some unknown location. "So this is the truth of the Holy Sect constantly抽取你的功力？" Ye Qing closed her eyes, tears streaming down her cheeks: "Every moment of every day... it's like being drained dry."

choices.memory_label: 陈机展现出冷静理性的一面，虽然让夜清感到失落，但也赢得了她的尊重

choices.description: Whether she acted against her will or not, she did harm you, harmed Su Qingyao, and nearly destroyed the careful layout you had built. People are not plants, how could they be without emotion—but the accounts still need to be settled.
choices.visible_cost: Possible rift in relationship with Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Understanding Ye Qing's complete psychological state when she was a chess piece

text.content: "Ye Qing." Chen Ji's voice was cold as millennia-old glacial ice, every word seeming to be squeezed through his clenched teeth. "I must ask you—when you used Demonic Path mist to scheme against me in the Yaming Valley, did you ever regret it for even a moment? Su Qingyao almost died in the trap you set—did you know that?" Ye Qing's body trembled violently, tears streaming from her eyes: "I know... I know everything... but I couldn't control myself... every time the brand activated, I became another person..." Chen Ji stepped forward abruptly, killing intent blazing in his eyes: "Couldn't control yourself? You think one phrase of 'couldn't control myself' can erase the consequences you caused? The wounds on Su Qingyao's body, the deaths of sect disciples—how do you plan to settle these accounts?" Ye Qing collapsed to the ground, eyes vacant, lips moving but no words coming out.

choices.memory_label: 陈机对夜清的质问虽然冷酷，但也展现了他护短的一面——苏青瑶的账，他都记着

text.content: Just as the atmosphere dropped to freezing point, subtle footsteps echoed from the corridor outside the secret chamber. Chen Ji's spiritual sense instantly tensed, and the Tianji Record Fragment at his wrist grew warm—heavy footsteps were approaching, and the visitors meant trouble. He swept his gaze across the chamber and discovered a hidden passage deep within, its entrance covered by thick dust. "Hide first." He whispered, pulling Ye Qing up from the ground and dragging her into the secret passage. Ye Qing leaned weakly against his shoulder, her breath fading as she said: "It's... people from the Holy Sect... they must have sensed the brand's disturbance..." Chen Ji covered her mouth, signaling her to stay silent. Outside the passage, flickering firelight cast multiple shadows approaching the chamber.

Through the narrow gap in the secret passage, Chen Ji clearly saw the arrivals—the leader was an elderly figure draped in black robes, with a withered face but eyes flickering with eerie red light, identical to the Heavenly Dao's Eye in the murals. Behind him followed several Demonic Path disciples, each with a miniature eyeball mark faintly visible between their brows. "The Saint's aura is right here." The black-robed elder's voice was hoarse and sharp. "She came to this place secretly again... This time, we absolutely cannot let her escape." Chen Ji's eyes sharpened abruptly, catching the key information from the elder's words—the word "again"? Could Ye Qing have sneaked into this place multiple times? And they, have been pursuing her all along?

dialogue.content: At this moment, the black-robed elder suddenly raised his head, his gaze shooting toward the secret passage like lightning. An indescribable pressure instantly engulfed the entire chamber, and Chen Ji felt his breathing grow labored. "Come out, successor of the Tianji Record." The elder's voice suddenly became hollow yet majestic, as if not emanating from him at all. "You think hiding in that passage can escape this seat's eyes?" Chen Ji's heart sank sharply—this voice was identical to the ancient, majestic voice that had emerged from the Tianji Record earlier, yet far more cold-blooded and high-handed. The Heavenly Dao's Eye... it could actually directly control Holy Sect members through the brand!

text.content: Chen Ji tightly grasped Ye Qing's ice-cold hand and whispered in her ear: "I'll draw them away later, you take the chance to escape." Ye Qing shook her head desperately, eyes full of terror and reluctance: "No... you don't know how powerful it is... last time I witnessed it... with just a single thought, it could shatter a Golden Core stage cultivator's soul on the spot..." Chen Ji gently patted the back of her hand, a meaningful smile curving at the corner of his lips: "Last time was last time. This time, it has encountered me." He released Ye Qing's hand and stepped slowly out of the secret passage, facing the overwhelming pressure. "The Heavenly Dao's Eye?" His voice was calm to the point of mockery. "Long have I heard the name. However—a cowardly eye hiding in darkness to peer at all living beings, daring to call itself 'this seat'?"

dialogue.content: The black-robed elder's lips twitched, those red-light-emanating eyes fixed死死地盯着陈机，仿佛要将他看穿："有意思……万年了，终于又有蝼蚁敢对本座口出狂言。" Chen Ji stared back without the slightest fear, the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve vibrating violently, as if resonating with some kind of force. He suddenly recalled Master Mo's words—the Tianji Record was the key to opening Heaven's cage. Then conversely, could it also be used to seal the Heavenly Dao's Eye's power? "You think the Tianji Record is your tool?" Chen Ji coldly smiled. "You're wrong. It was never a key—it is the cage itself." The moment his words fell, the fragment suddenly burst forth with blinding golden light, illuminating the entire chamber bright as daylight.

text.content: Under the golden light's impact, the black-robed elder's body convulsed violently, the eyeball mark between his brows flickering frantically, as if engaged in a desperate struggle against some force. "This... this is impossible!" The elder released a roar not his own. "How could a mere fragment—" Before he could finish, his body suddenly stiffened, and诡异的 black blood seeped from all seven orifices. Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, watching this puppet controlled by the Heavenly Dao's Eye, his smile deepening: "It seems your power hasn't fully recovered yet, unable to even properly control a mortal body." He stepped forward slowly, voice dropping several degrees. "I'm curious—if you fully awaken, how many lives would you need for sacrifice? Su Qingyao? Ye Qing? Or... my sister who disappeared years ago?"

At this moment, a凌厉的剑气从暗道中激射而出，直取黑袍老者的咽喉！ Chen Ji's pupils constricted, instinctively wanting to intervene, yet he discovered the sword qi's trajectory was extremely bizarre—it wasn't aimed at killing the elder, but precisely severing the connection between the elder and the mark on his brow. As the sword qi dissipated, the elder's eyes rolled back and he collapsed straight to the ground. The Demonic Path disciples behind the black-robed elder immediately descended into chaos, some shouting "Protect the护法！" while others seized the chance to flee toward the chamber's exit. At the secret passage entrance, a familiar figure slowly emerged—Ye Qing held a jet-black short sword, face pale yet gaze resolute: "Chen Ji, I will no longer let anyone control my destiny—包括 it."

Chen Ji looked at the short sword in Ye Qing's hand, brow furrowing slightly. He recognized that sword—it was the legacy relic Ye Qing carried as the Saint, called "Soul Devourer," capable of severing all connections related to the soul. "You're insane?" Chen Jiwhispered说道。 "The price of severing the brand is your own lifespan!" Ye Qing gave a tragic smile, blood seeping from the corner of her mouth: "I've long tired of living. Every time it controlled me to do things against my true heart, I wished I could die immediately... Now, finally, I can." Her body swayed, dropping to one knee, but the light in her eyes shone brighter than ever before. "Chen Ji, thank you... thank you for letting me know that I still have the right to choose."

Looking at this woman who had been toyed with by fate yet never given up, the anger Chen Ji had suppressed for so long finally found an outlet. He stepped forward, pulling Ye Qing up and letting her lean against his chest. "Who said you were tired of living?" His voice was low yet firm. "Your life, I Chen Ji have claimed. From now on, no one shall treat you as a chess piece—not even the Heavenly Dao's Eye." The Tianji Record Fragment hummed again, Master Mo's voice sounding in his Mental Sea: "Successor, are you certain about this? Although the brand in Ye Qing's body has been severed, her lifespan is damaged and her foundation destroyed. To save her, you need to pay..." Chen Ji replied coldly in his heart: "How much?" Master Mo沉默片刻： "One complete page of the Tianji Record's power, plus ten years of your lifespan."

Chen Ji did not hesitate. The fragment in his sleeve suddenly unfurled, golden light enveloping Ye Qing's weakened body. He could feel his life force draining away at an alarming rate, his Mental Sea throbbing with pain, yet his expression remained serene as still water. Ye Qing's body gradually regained a trace of color, and those grotesque black lines slowly faded away. "Is it worth it?" Master Mo sighed. Chen Ji gave no answer, only lowering his gaze to that pale yet stubborn face in his arms, the corner of his lips curving slightly upward: "She is worth it." Footsteps outside the chamber grew nearer, and Chen Ji knew the next wave of enemies would arrive soon. But he was not flustered—because he had already planned his next move. "Ye Qing, can you walk?" Ye Qing nodded, forcing herself to stand: "Yes... This time, I want to fight side by side with you."

Just as the two prepared to leave the chamber, Chen Ji's脚步忽然一顿。 His gaze fell upon the line of text scratched out on the stone wall—"魔道圣女，轮回之痛，意志烙印激活条件". He crouched down, carefully examining the erased text. Relying on his exceptional memory and understanding of text, he pieced together the complete content word by word: "每逢月圆之夜，圣女之血与天机之眼产生共鸣，届时预言者将不由自主地走向死亡。" Chen Ji's瞳孔suddenly收缩——Moonlit night? Today is the fifteenth! His gaze snapped toward the chamber entrance, where a figure was walking against the firelight. Moonlight fell from behind her, illuminating a face more familiar than any could be—Su Qingyao. Her gaze was vacant, yet a诡异的 smile hung at the corner of her mouth, identical to Ye Qing when she was controlled by the Heavenly Dao's Eye moments ago. "Chen Ji..." Her voice was gentle yet carried bone-deep coldness. "我来接你了。"
